notes.title: Welcome to Online Co-op in the ‘Fellowship Sanctuary’ update!
notes.content:
Hello Family!

[b]The day you all have been patiently waiting for has finally come. Today Children of Morta gets its most anticipated free update - the online co-op. What’s more - everyone willing to try it can now download the game for free on Steam for a limited time.[/b]

You know it’s better to face challenges together. See this in the trailer here:
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=JrvARwiOW0o

The heroic Bergson family began their epic journey with the launch of Children of Morta in September 2019, and the online co-op update marks the eighth and final stop on the game’s Development Roadmap. Previous  updates introduced new difficulty levels, the Family Trails mode, a new playable character, and more. In addition, the ‘Paws and Claws’ charity DLC helped raise thousands of dollars for Humane Society International. Now, the Online Co-op update is available for all players for free (note the console version is still in the works).

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11885669/71a410e3fb5b638aea139ca60f1083f69bebc56f.jpg[/img]

The introduction of an online co-op means that noble warriors from distant lands can fight side by side, and those brave enough to pick up against the Corruption can foretaste this adventure without any cost. If you’re willing to invite to a co-op session a friend who doesn’t have the game in his Steam library, then Children of Morta will be available for free to try on Steam between February 14th at 7 PM CET (10 AM PT, 1 PM ET) and February 18th at 7 PM CET (10 AM PT, 1 PM ET).

For those enjoying monster-slaying during the free period, Children of Morta will be significantly discounted with minus 65% for the base game, and minus 60% for the Complete Edition, containing also both paid DLC-s (Paws and Claws charity DLC/Ancient Spirits new character DLC).

Finally, the Onlice Co-op is available in both game modes - Story and Family Trials!

Best,
Dead Mage & 11 bit studios

notes.title: The awaited Co-op Update "The Fellowship Sanctuary" comes on Feb. 14th!
notes.content:
Hello Family!

11 bit studios and Dead Mage will mark the last update on the Children of Morta Development Roadmap with the release of The Fellowship Sanctuary on Steam on Feb. 14th, 2022. The final of a whopping 8 free updates to the successful rogue-lite adventure is highlighted by the long-awaited online co-op mode allowing for two valiant warriors to team up against the ever-oppressive Corruption together.

Have a bit of upcoming fun in the teaser here! https://youtu.be/iMxgXnp7-1U

While Steam players will be able to enjoy online co-op on Feb. 14th, the Dead Mage team is still hard at work on bringing the same experience to consoles. In efforts to assure the same quality across all platforms, the development team is adamant to get everything right before releasing it. We don’t currently have a release window on this update, but endeavor to keep all our valuable console players in the know as development continues. We truly appreciate our community’s continued patience and support in this matter.

Alongside the Feb. 14th release, Children of Morta will be enjoying a free-to-play offer on Steam so anyone can try the game for themselves.

notes.title: Japanese Voice-Over for Children of Morta
notes.content:
Hi Family!

As you probably know, in one of our most recent updates, we've released our full Japanese Voice-Over localization for Children of Morta.

We're extremely proud to have on board, as our Narrator, the industry veteran Takaya Hashi, whose roles include ones on [b]Fist of the North Star[/b] ([i]Toki, Amiba[/i]), [b]Naruto Shippuden[/b] ([i]Kakuzu[/i]), [b]Sailor Moon S[/b] ([i]Sergei Azimov[/i], [i]Ventriloquist[/i]), [b]Full Metal Alchemist[/b] ([i]Majhal[/i]), [b]Beastars[/b] ([i]Boss[/i]), [b]Pokémon[/b] ([i]Munō[/i]), [b]Metal Gear Solid[/b] ([i]Skull Face[/i]), [b]Harry Potter[/b] ([i]Severus Snape[/i]) or [b]Witcher 3: The Wild Hunt [/b]([i]Emhyr var Emreis[/i]), to name just a few over the 36 years he's been a voice actor for anime and video games!

[previewyoutube=b84o0O4CYn8;full][/previewyoutube]

All of this was possible thanks to our partner in Japan, DMM GAMES, who helped us release and promote the game within the country - please visit their [url=https://dlsoft.dmm.com]official website[/url] if you are looking for your very own Japanese edition of the game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11885669/b14b5b91d5b1d6fe26e8159a287a3b411a15b4f8.jpg[/img]

The DMM GAMES team was able to ask about Mr. Hashi's thoughts on the whole recording process:

[b]ENGLISH[/b]
[list]
[*] [i] Q. What was the most important/difficult part of recording Children of Morta?
[*] A. I didn't have any pictures or images at the time, so I had to imagine the situation in my mind while recording. There were a lot of parts that I couldn't visualize, so it was a tough job, haha. [/i]
[/list]
[list]
[*] [i] Q. Do you have a message for people looking forward to the game?
[*] A. There were many differences in sound length between the original and Japanese, so I asked the director to think about it, or I tried myself. I haven't seen the game yet and I can't wait. Hope all users enjoy it![/i]
[/list]

[b]JAPANESE[/b]
[list]
[*] [i] Q. Children of Mortaの収録において力を入れた(難しかった)ところを教えてください。
[*] A. そのときどきの絵がまだ無かったので、状況を自分の中でイメージしながら収録しました。イメージできない箇所も多々あり、なかなか手ごわい作品でしたね(笑) [/i]
[/list]
[list]
[*] [i] Q. ゲームを楽しみにしている方に向けてメッセージをお願い致します。
[*] A. 原音と日本語の長さに相違がある場合が多くあり、演出の方に考えていただいたり、自分で変えてみたりしました。どんな映像になったのかまだ拝見していないので、私自身も楽しみにしています。皆さんもどうぞお楽しみに。[/i]
[/list]

We have literal CHILLS listening to Mr. Hashi's performance, and we hope you enjoy his rendition of the Narrator just as much! 

With best wishes,
Dead Mage & 11 bit studios

notes.title: Children of Morta – Family Trials Mode is Available Now!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11885669/3a8443bf63f40b7a069c5dab15ed338dd2fbf124.jpg[/img]

Greetings, Family!

Children of Morta’s biggest update yet is now live on PC, Nintendo Switch, PlayStation 4, and Xbox One. Family Trials is a combat-focused game mode and all users can now hop into the fast-paced action for free. 

https://youtu.be/N7MidGYpq8c
[b]« About Family Trials Mode »[/b]
Family Trials mode revolves around Zyklus, a unique and abnormal Dungeon located somewhere in Rea. The Zyklus Dungeon is quite unstable - its nature and rules rapidly change, following an obscure, chaotic cycle affected by the Corruption itself. [b]Bergsons use this mysterious place to test their skills and limits[/b] - so they're better prepared to face the dangers that await them in the Land of Rea. 

From the gameplay perspective, [b]Family Trials is completely separate from the Main Story campaign of the game. It offers new systems, items, character builds possibilities[/b] and more - all set in a series of [b]completely randomized dungeons[/b]. It is also quite challenging - most of the progress is lost when you die in the dungeon - so you better prepare to learn from your mistakes!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11885669/304719b80eccb22cfeb1f36a2ea0afadb5afddbd.jpg[/img]

[b]« Family Trials Mode - the basics »[/b]
[list]
[*] [b]Complete main objectives and optional side-objectives[/b] and advance to the next floor.  Objectives vary from protecting the Rea Laborers from waves of enemies, fighting in the arena - to surviving the flood of corrupted adversaries, and more!
[*] [b]Unlock two additional difficulty levels[/b]: Hard and Insane. The higher difficulty, the more levels you have to beat!
[*] [b]Experiment with your character builds[/b] and learn from your mistakes to best your consecutive dungeon runs.
[*] [b]Levels are completely randomized[/b] each time you enter the dungeons.
[*] All Bergson family members and their active abilities [b]are available from the very beginning[/b].

notes.content:

[i]"Gather round, travellers weary, 
Rest warmly beside our fireplace,
These are tales to make you cheery, 
Hear their restful, soothing grace."[/i]
– Author Unknown.

Hello there, Family!

As you [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/330020/view/3043843025211700088]already know[/url], Family Trials - a new free game mode for our action-RPG Children of Morta - is just around the corner. Today, we are thrilled to shed a bit more light on this new content and share a unique surprise prepared alongside Children of Morta’s beloved narrator, Ed Kelly.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11885669/08404c4d51d9d4ffd9a1fd1939f0f124332c4f0f.jpg[/img]

[b]« About the upcoming Family Trials Mode »[/b]
Family Trials is a combat-oriented experience that is independent of the story-focused campaign. This major update is all about chopping your way through the game’s perilous dungeons all while completing objectives and constructing the ultimate character builds to purge all the monsters, sub-bosses, and bosses that stand in your way. [b]Three difficulty levels[/b] offer a mounting challenge and affect the number of [b]randomly generated levels[/b] in each run - yet the family's efforts will be handsomely rewarded with [b]upgradable Divine Relics and Graces, frequent item drops, and a brand-new Talent System.[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11885669/cca9d230efe4ab9ac0386c3eacf76bc81d85014e.gif[/img]

[b]« About Family Fireside Fables »[/b]
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1556830/Children_of_Morta_Family_Fireside_Fables/]Family Fireside Fables[/url] is a pack of six charming tales, ranging from adventurous to mysterious, read by the game’s unmistakable narrator, Ed Kelly. The Land of Rea has always been filled with touching stories, collected by the Bergson family for generations, and this was a natural fit. Now, the gentle tone of Ed’s voice, accompanied by exquisite soundscapes and music from Hamidreza Ansari’s extraordinary Children of Morta Official Soundtrack, will carry you into the land of fantasies, morals, and poetic rhymes. Be carried away by the magic of Family Fireside Fables on the platform of your choice: 

» Grab it on [b]Steam[/b]:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1556830/Children_of_Morta_Family_Fireside_Fables/

» Listen and watch on [b]YouTube[/b]: 
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=UBpa29IRwvw&list=PLpas7-jjCh0aXc4MP4eY2mAaQVcfctfcb

[b]Family Fireside Fables Table of Contents:[/b]
[list]
[*] Tale I: [url=https://youtu.be/UBpa29IRwvw][i]Home[/i][/url] — by Anne Bronte
[*] Tale II: [url=https://youtu.be/s_Xg_lBLxEk][i]Brother and Sister[/i][/url] — by the Grimm Brothers
[*] Tale III: [url=https://youtu.be/WXnXyVwZTZs][i]Lucy[/i][/url] — by George Pope Morris
[*] Tale IV: [url=https://youtu.be/mVYp6rwMjKY][i]The Turnip[/i][/url] — by the Grimm Brothers
[*] Tale V: [url=https://youtu.be/zDZc7Wy4bIg][i]The Raven[/i][/url] — by Edgar Allan Poe
[*] Tale VI: [url=https://youtu.be/FxcT9_-8iyc][i]Mother[/i][/url] —  by Madison Julius Cawein

We hope that those few tales will make your evenings more pleasant and stay with you for some time. Let us know what you think about our little fairy-tale side-project in the comments and hey - if you like it, maybe one day we could produce a Vol. II?

Safe travels, Adventurers! 
Dead Mage & 11 bit studios

notes.title: Children of Morta | Community Update - March 2021
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11885669/34ee2564918b9638e9c54fbe64e2b2325579e099.jpg[/img]

Hi there, Family!

We hope that the year 2021 has treated you well so far. We are doing great but we’re also quite busy. What are we cooking, you ask? Well, some content for [i]Children of Morta[/i], obviously! Lands of Rea are rather dangerous in some places - that’s why from time to time it is wise to create a detour in your travels. And it’s especially nice if you find some unexpected rewards while discovering new routes, right? So that’s exactly what we did. [b]Here’s a quick summary of our adventures from 2020 and some plans for 2021. [/b]

[b] « THE STORY SO FAR » [/b]
2020 was a tough year for all of us. A global pandemic, social unrest, major natural disasters. Everyone copes with tough situations differently - and we happen to be a bunch of proper gaming [strike]nerds[/strike] aficionados, so that’s what we have focused on: [b]making stuff for our game for you to enjoy[/b]. We hope that by creating new content for [i]Children of Morta[/i] we’ve provided you with a portion of much-needed escapism. In 2020, we have delivered [b]5 significant updates to the game and four of them were completely free[/b]. Through those updates, we’ve added things like [b]Items Packs, New Game+ Mode, new difficulty settings, a brand new playable character, and more! [/b]

The paid DLC, however, was a different story and was very special for us - ‘cause it gave a spotlight to something that we care about deeply: our animal friends. [b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1317160/Children_of_Morta_Paws_and_Claws/][i]Paws and Claws DLC[/i][/url][/b] - while it obviously adds new features to the game (like the Animal Shelter System, new boosts, animations and events) -  it first and foremost focuses on helping animals in the real world. [b]100% of 11 bit studios and Dead Mage's proceeds from selling this piece of content go to the Humane Society International charity organization[/b]. We’re super proud to announce that this way we’ve already raised more than [b]$100k[/b] (and this number is still growing!) for animals around the world - and it’s all thanks to you! Thank you so much for supporting Paws and Claws DLC, folks!

Now, let’s see what the future holds for us, shall we? 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11885669/b132b795ac1c4860bc4e67ec6ed158e063a2612e.jpg[/img]
[url=https://childrenofmorta.com/wp-content/uploads/2021/03/com_roadmap_update_march_2021.jpg][i]Click here for a full-sized map.[/i][/url]

[b] « NEW ROUTES ON  THE ROADMAP » [/b]
As you can see, there are some[b] alterations to our route[/b] and we’d like to shed some light on what happened here and what we had to change over the course of the last few months.

Our initial plan for the last three updates was simple: 1) deliver a rather straightforward and basic endless mode for the game; 2) then add the online co-op functionality and last but not least - 3) create a bigger piece of paid content that would feel like a separate mode of the game. Those were the three upcoming points on our previous roadmap. However, what we have learned by creating the [i]Uncharted Lands[/i] (paid DLC) - is that it would organically work better if we have actually merged some of its features with the Endless Mode, delivering [b]a brand new experience in a shorter amount of time[/b]. A win-win situation, so to speak.

Let us be fully transparent here: we kinda felt that the basic endless mode ([i]The Temple of The Endless[/i] Update on the roadmap) that we’ve implemented and tested back in the day didn’t add that much to the game. It was functional, you would’ve enjoyed it for sure - but it wasn’t a major game-changer. We felt it’s not enough - even as a fun little free update. But by borrowing some mechanics from the paid DLC content - we could’ve created something special that almost feels like a game within a game. So... that’s exactly what we did. [b]That’s how the Family Trials Mode was born! [/b]

And there’s a surprise here, too. Even though it was supposed to be a paid DLC, [b]we decided to make it totally free to thank you all for supporting us by buying the game and the Paws and Claws Charity DLC.[/b]

[b] » Long story short: there is no paid DLC coming anymore at a later stage - instead of that you’re getting a bigger, super fun, free content update in the form of Family Trials Mode.[/b]

We’re going to share more information about the new content later down the road. But we don’t want to leave you empty-handed so for now, here’s a sneak peek of the totally new hub area that will welcome you to the [i]Family Trials [/i]Mode:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11885669/98800fb0ef6983610d08b5a1704854482657990a.jpg[/img]
[url=https://childrenofmorta.com/wp-content/uploads/2021/03/com_fireplace.jpg][i]Click here to see the high-resolution version[/i][/url] (and set it as your wallpaper, preferably).

Oh, you would like to see more? Ok, ok, fine, here’s a short teaser, then:
https://youtu.be/Q6wpq3tTInk

[b] « ONLINE CO-OP » [/b]
We know you’re all waiting for the online co-op functionality to be added to Children of Morta. Believe us, we want to see you wreaking havoc on your enemies without the restraints of the local co-op, too - [b]but the only thing we can confirm at the moment is that we’re still working on it, it’s not canceled or anything like that.[/b] We can’t give you any dates here. The only new piece of info is that the upcoming [i]Family Trials [/i]Mode will also use that online co-op support in the future.

Okay, Fam, that’s all the news that we have for you today! If you would like to stay up to date with everything we do, please follow us on [url=https://twitter.com/ChildrenOfMorta]Twitter[/url] and [url=https://www.facebook.com/ChildrenOfMorta]Facebook[/url]. Stay safe and awesome!

Cheers,
[i]Dead Mage and 11 bit studios[/i]

Hi there, Family!

Valiant protectors of the land of Rea, the Bergsons are a beacon of hope for all of Rea’s citizens, both human and animal. Much like the Bergsons, we at 11 bit studios and Dead Mage love our animal friends too, and that’s why we’ve partnered with [url=https://www.hsi.org/][b]Humane Society International[/b][/url] to launch [i]Paws and Claws[/i], a charity DLC for [i]Children of Morta[/i]! The DLC is available now on PC, Xbox One, Nintendo Switch, and PlayStation 4!

[b]Watch the most wholesome and heartwarming trailer for a DLC ever: [/b]https://youtu.be/HYdBAMT_GcY 
In order to protect Rea’s creatures with paws and claws -- and beaks, wings, fur, or horns -- the Bergsons’ homestead will see an entirely new section added. Of course, caring for all these animals means new responsibilities for the family members, and looking after them will add to their daily routines, but the selfless and soothing presence of your various friends could be rewarding and affect the heroes in further battles. And that’s not all -- [b]a bunch of freshly brewed items have been added with[i] a free 'A Treasure!' Update[/i] available for all players - whether you own the [i]Paws and Claws DLC[/i] or not[/b]! Containing new relics, consumables, and divine graces -- that could, for instance, spawn laser traps around you or protect the Bergsons with breathing fire -- there’s a little something for everyone!

[b]Get the DLC [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1317160/ ]here[/url]: [/b]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1317160/ 

[i]Notice: 100% of 11 bit studios and Dead Mage's proceeds go to the Humane Society International charity![/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11885669/bf9e841637548b88342d2373f3a8366262d15fab.jpg[/img]

[i]“Paws and Claws is the kind of content that embraces the meaningfulness that we’re often pouring into our games. Animals are a big part of the original Children of Morta story, so enriching relationships with them in the game felt natural. [b]And collaborating with an organization like Humane Society International perfectly fits 11 bit studios’ mindset since we believe that a company producing meaningful games should also act meaningfully[/b]”[/i] - said Karol Kała, Producer of [i]Children of Morta[/i].

[b]100% of 11 bit studios and Dead Mage proceeds from Paws and Claws DLC go to the Humane Society International charity[/b], whose main mission is to help animals all over the world. So, just as a quick summary: [b]you need to buy the Paws and Claws DLC to get all the new animal-related content - and this way, you are supporting Humane Society International.[/b] But you'll still get the new items from [i]A Treasure! notes.title: Bergsons' House - New Character Added! | Free Content Update
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11885669/72f1db0ea39cf7f102465ed4836e2f95d6029314.jpg[/img]

Hi there, Family!

We bring you some news from far-away lands! [b]Bergsons’ House Update introduces a brand-new hero: Apan, a versatile mid-range champion[/b], capable of covering a large area with her staff and spells while using a set of all-new runes and skills. Learn more about her story and skills from our latest video: https://youtu.be/R5UruY0FgPI

[h1][b]Apan’s Introduction - Story:[/b][/h1] 
[i]Among the Asva tribe, she is known as “Clan Mother”. She was barely out of childhood when her talent for healing started to show. As a youth, she would participate in her tribe’s battles to treat and nurse the soldiers but wasn’t above picking up a weapon and fight when it was called for.

In one of those wars, she nursed to health a young warrior named Dhal, the son of their tribe chief, from critical wounds. They started courting and got married on the midsummer day, under the lucky shade of willows. As a gift, on their marriage day, Dhal gave Apan a magical dragon-shaped flying kite, upon which she could ride over the entire lands of the north in a day and a night.

Years later, when she spied the amassed pitch-black clouds in the distant south, she decided that she was needed in the midlands, and she arrived there to give aid to the Bergsons in their fight against the Corruption.[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11885669/53894f09d06162dc828cfa372e506d6fbb1169b7.png[/img]

[h1][b]Apan’s Introduction - Gameplay:[/b][/h1] 
Apan is as skilled in providing vital support for the companions on the battlefield as in wielding a sturdy staff. Weapons’ reach makes Apan perfect for [b]delivering deadly mid-range strikes and her special Asva Pulse dash ability leaves the opponents hindered in the dust[/b]. Her spells cover a [b]large area of effect[/b], and all the Bergsons can take advantage from Apan’s medical knowledge as [b]she boosts the effects of the healing potions[/b]. Also,[b] a new system lets the family gain shields from items, abilities, and Apan’s Rage skill[/b]. In other words - her presence makes them all stronger, especially in the battle.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11885669/505e3972f25e1af156bf338a5e2af858462c1466.png[/img]

[h1][b]Apan’s Introduction - Origins:[/b][/h1]
We're also super happy to say that [b]the new character design was done by a backer and his partner from the game’s Kickstarter campaign[/b]! They believed in our project since the very early stage and we are super thankful for that! Here's what these backers - known as [b]AgaRar and GlueBubble[/b] - had to say about the idea that inspired the Apan's creation: [i]“The idea for Apan came from the brainstorming of myself and my partner. We originally made her an orphan but later changed her to a mother to better compliment the Children of Morta story and family theme. A strong leader of nomadic healers who allies herself with the Bergsons to aid them in their fight against Corruption. We hope that our inspiration and Dead Mage's hard work translates into a character that you all will enjoy for years to come.”[/i].

[h1][b]General features list:[/b][/h1]
[b]Bergsons’ House Update[/b] is now available on all platforms: Xbox One, PC (Steam, GOG.com, Humble Store), PS4 and Nintendo Switch. The free update contains:
[list]
[*] [b]A brand-new character with a unique skillset designed to play in single-player, but shine in co-op playthroughs[/b]
[*] Special shielding skills and passive healing mechanics
[*] 32 new Apan-specific Runes
[*] 9 new story Cutscenes
[*] a few HUD and UI tweaks
[*] additional bug fixes
[/list]
We hope you like this new addition to the Bergsons' family! Be sure to let us know what you think in the comments!

[h1][b]Full change log = even more details:[/b][/h1] 
And last but not least, here's the [b]detailed list of all new features, changes, tweaks and fixes.[/b] As usual, some of those may contain some super small hints/spoilers about the game's lore - but nothing to be really alarmed about!

[b]Main Apan skills:[/b]
[list][i][b]Asva Thunderclap[/b][/i]
Apan focuses the energy around her and releases it at enemies to push back, slow, and damage them.

[i][b]Magic Glyph[/b][/i]
Using her staff, Apan channels energy around her, creating an area that damages and slows enemies in it.
[i][b]
Guardian’s Rage[/b][/i]
Apan unleashes her rage at a protective manner, granting shield to herself and the Bergsons around her.[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11885669/761dca13ef48cad0f41b7dbd28695775759d7046.jpg[/img]

[b]Added 32 Apan-specific Runes and 6 new Runes for other Bergsons to aid them in combat:[/b]
[list]
[*] Apan Trait for Linda: the primary critical attack has a chance to gain a shield
[*] Apan Trait for Kevin: Kevin gains shield when he exits shadow dance
[*] Apan Trait for John: the primary attack has a chance to gain a shield
[*] Apan Trait for Lucy: when lucy uses her decoy, she gains a shield
[*] Apan Trait for Mark: marks gains shield when he uses his stick
[*] Apan Trait for Joey: joey's smite gives him a shield
[/list]
[b]Added new Shield System:[/b]
[list]
[*] Bergsons can [b]gain shield now, from items, abilities and Apan’s Guardian Rage skill[/b]
[*] The shield will add on top of HP bar in HUD with an indicator of the amount of shield
[*] Shields are temporary and can stack up
[*] When characters have shield all of the receiving damages will be blocked by it till the shield amount ends or shield duration finished.
[*] Lucy Guardian Rage skill will now add her Shield instead of increasing her maximum health
[/list]
[b]Added new Rage Globes drop:[/b]
Added new Rage Globes drop - refill your rage meter faster! Rage Globes drop with the similar rules as Health Globes. [b][i]Note: Rage Globes will be added to Nintendo Switch version of the game in a few days[/i][/b], so don’t be alarmed if you don’t see it there, yet!

[b]HUD Tooltip Rework:[/b][list]
[*] Buff panel now supports and shows more character buffs, including the passive skill of characters skill tree
[*] Buffs now auto-scroll when players have more than 9 buffs in normal HUD size and 7 buffs in Larger HUD
[*] Divine Grace tooltip also will auto-scroll when players have more than 8 relics
[*] Runes are now visible on the minimap
[/list]
[b]UI changes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Added HP indicator for Decoys and Totem Divine Relics
[*] Added Time indicator for Decoys and Totem Divine Relics
[/list]
[b]Bug fixes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed several issues with Gambler prompts 
[*] Fixed missing narration for Goblin King event in Magma dungeon 
[*] Fixed several issues with texts overlap on the UI
[*] Fixed rocket targeting in Magma Dungeon 
[*] Fixed the issue where the first dungeon of a Chapter was always highlighted upon opening the Dungeon selection screen
[*] Increased spawn rate for Stones required for Wine Machine event
[*] Several additional small bugfixes
[/list]
[b]How to unlock the new character (minor spoilers):[/b]
[olist]
[*] Apan will be unlocked after watching her intro cutscene.
[*] Apan intro cutscene conditions are met when players reach the second floor of Ziggurat dungeon in Barahut chapter.
[*] If in the loaded save slot players have cleared the Ziggurat dungeon already, Apan intro cutscene will be played by going to any dungeon and returning home.
[*] Apan intro cutscene has less "weight" against main story cutscenes. If there are other cutscenes in the queue, Apan intro cutscene will not play till all of the important cutscenes are watched in the house. 
[/olist]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11885669/c2226595fe9b6aabc7d6e5ecea66117336a3d5b7.png[/img]

[h1][b]Development Roadmap Update[/b][/h1] 
On top of that, we have some new info about the upcoming updates! [b]Here's the current state of our journey along the Development Roadmap:[/b]
1. Free Update #1: Shrine of Challenge - [b]Visited on Feb 2nd, 2020.[/b]
2. Free Update #2: Setting Sun Inn - [b]Visited on May 7th, 2020.[/b]
3. Free Update #3: Bergsons' House - [b]Visited on June 24th, 2020.[/b]
4. Free Update #4: A Treasure! + Random Encounter Update (it's still a secret!)
5. Free Update #5: Temple of The Endless
6. Free Update #6: The Fellowship Sanctuary
7. Paid DLC Update.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11885669/8c1bc8432cb585d515e6a6f4fd7c42955a8e4042.jpg[/img]
[url=https://childrenofmorta.com/wp-content/uploads/2020/06/children_of_morta_roadmap_updated.jpg]CLICK HERE TO VIEW THE HIGHER RESOLUTION.[/url]

As you've noticed by now, even with a map in hand, sometimes we have to take detours and diverge from our original path. "Not all those who wander are lost", however. [b]We absolutely still plan to deliver all the promised content, we just had to change the order of the updates and merge one with another.[/b]

That's all the news for today! We hope you like the new content. If you want to be up to date with all the Children of Morta news - be sure to follow @ChildrenOfMorta and @11bitstudios on Twitter!

Stay safe!
Dead Mage & 11 bit studios

Hi there, folks!

We have some pretty exciting news for you! Making its way to Xbox One, Nintendo Switch, PlayStation 4, and PC, [b]Children of Morta has just received pricing across all platforms[/b]. Developed by Dead Mage and published by 11 bit studios, [b]Children of Morta will be available digitally for $21.99 USD and €21.99 later this summer![/b] While knowing the price is nice, what’s nicer is the stunning box art for the game that has also been released today! 

You can see it above in the full version, or below - on a boxed, retail edition mock-up. We're really happy with how it turned out - and we hope you like it, too!

[h1][b]What is Children of Morta?[/b][/h1]
Children of Morta sets its story in a distant land but copes with themes closer to our daily lives that one would expect. It is a story of the simple emotions we all know so well — and value more than sometimes we dare to admit — [b]love and hope, longing and uncertainty, ultimately loss and the sacrifices we are willing to make to save the ones we care the most for.[/b]
 
Embark on the adventure of an[b] extraordinary family of heroes[/b]. With the Corruption spreading through the land, the guardians of the Mountain Morta have to stand up against an ancient evil. But… it’s not a story about saving the universe. [b]It’s a story about a valiant family standing together while the world around them is being devoured by darkness.[/b]

[h1][b]Features:[/b][/h1]
[list]
[*] rogue-lite with a [b]strong story line[/b]
[*][b] 6 unique playable characters[/b]
[*] [b]emotional tale focused on a family of heroes[/b]
[*] diverse set of skills and attributes
[*] passive and active items modifying each run
[*] multiple dungeons set in different biomes
[*] rich world full of history and magic
[*] uncommon hand-painted pixel art style
[/list]
[h1][b]Be sure to add Children of Morta to your Steam Wishlist:[/b][/h1]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/330020/Children_of_Morta/
 
[h1][b]Retail version details.[/b][/h1]
The boxed editions from Merge Games will be released on Nintendo Switch, PlayStation 4 and PC (in Europe and Australia) alongside the digital releases.

And if you're interested, pricing for the [u]retail*[/u] version is as follows:

[/list]
*[b]Of course, Children of Morta will be also available digitally for $21.99 USD and €21.99[/b].

And as a bonus, here's Lucy, practicing her fireball skills:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11885669/abac15064cc9e5a315fe55435e2e33b2cee253cc.jpg[/img]

Obviously, we're working on some new, cool materials (and a *huge* surprise for all of you) as well, so stay tuned for more news in the upcoming weeks!

Have a good one,

notes.title: Children of Morta moved to 2019.
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11885669/a236f40c8788da3bc150284ae727ea01de7c5f49.jpg[/img]

Hello there, friends!

[h1]So, as some of you might have already expected, [b]we have decided to postpone Children of Morta to 2019[/b].[/h1] 

Our goal is to deliver a mind-blowing, story-driven hack n’ slasher — and we’ll get there — but the journey is going to take a bit longer than expected. 

“[i]Having [b]a solid amount of feedback[/b] after shows like PAX Prime, and knowing exactly the goal we need to reach, we have decided to move the release date of Children of Morta, on all platforms, to 2019[/i]”, says Producer, Marek Ziemak. “[i]There is huge potential for this gem and we know how to fulfill it, so some things are already put in motion. I strongly believe in Mr. Miyamoto’s words about delaying a game to make sure it’s brilliant when it releases and nothing less. Also, and I believe this is important from the gaming community’s perspective,[b] we are now developing Children of Morta for all four major platforms and there will be a simultaneous launch on all of them - Xbox One, PlayStation 4, Nintendo Switch and PC.[/b][/i]”

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11885669/2780780946c13a0c5f7fcb7a7355723d20d14ad2.jpg[/img]

The biggest and most time-consuming change is Children of Morta’s growth. The[b] game is increasing significantly in size[/b], as each of the three biomes the player can visit in the game will now have [b]more levels and they’re larger overall[/b]. Another addition we’ve made is [b]mini-bosses awaiting at the end of each level[/b]. notes.title: Build Version 0.17 Is Now Available!
notes.content:
[h1]Character Customization and Progression[/h1]
[list]
[*]Character Upgrade Menu Altered: A new ability tree designed to allow players to manually unlock and upgrade character abilities has replaced the previous system of automatically gaining abilities on level up.
[*]Ability Runes Added. There are currently 5 - 6 runes for each ability slot of a character, each altering the way the ability behaves. Runes are dropped by dead enemies and can be found inside chests and other lootable objects during dungeon runs. All Ability Runes are removed upon returning home.
[*]Inventory Slots Added: Each character can equip up to two items. Items are shared among the family and can be equipped to multiple characters at once.
[*]Characters can now upgrade unique passive abilities.
[/list]

[h1]Crafting and Resources[/h1]
[list]
[*]Schematics and Crafting Added: Ring and Amulet schematics can now be found during dungeon runs. A new menu at home allows Uncle Ben to craft and upgrade these items for Common and/or Rare Gems. Schematics are gained from resolving in-dungeon events, defeating bosses and Challenge Rooms as well as a small chance from opening chests.
[*]Resource Altered: Crystals have been replaced by Common and Rare Gems. This new currency is used primarily in crafting and stacks between dungeon runs.
[*]Resource Added: Souls are a special resource limited to one dungeon run that can now be harvested from dead enemies. Soul count resets upon returning home.
[*]Destructibles Added: Destructible objects now exist in dungeons with a chance to release gems, health globes, and Ability Runes.
[/list]

[h1]Events/Encounters[/h1]
[list]
[*]Small and Giant Chests Added: These new chests reward gems, health globes, and runes. Giant chests require a soul to unlock, but have a small chance to drop schematics.
[*]Interactable Objects Added: New objects scattered throughout dungeons (dead corpses, broken wagons, etc.) can be interacted with a chance for an item of use to drop.
[*]Sacred Shrines Added: Sacred Shrines now rest in dungeons. Activating them at the expense of Souls provides various temporary boosts.
[*]Narrative Events and Quests Added: An additional four Narrative Events and Quests have been added to the Caeldippo Caves.
[*]New Gameplay Event Added: A new puzzle-focused event can now be found.
[*]Challenge Room Encounter Added: Challenge Rooms now have a chance to spawn a mini-boss instead of enemy waves. Mini-bosses are a weakened version of the previous Boss Monster.
[*]Caeldippo Cave Boss Added: The rightful boss has now appeared, replacing his vicious minion!
[*]Anai-Daya Chamber (Boss Room) Updated: The boss room has received a major visual upgrade to create a more epic environment to combat in!
[*]Dark Corruption Portals Added: Corrupted portals have a small chance to appear from defeated enemies that continue to spawn Corrupted enemies in the location to keep a dungeon from ever feeling too safe.
[*]Enemy Added: Dark Worm
[*]Additional Environmental Hazard Combinations Added
[*]Summoning Circles now appear more organically in the environment instead of in a particular room.
[/list]

[h1]Bergson Home[/h1]
[list]
[*]Sanctuary Added: Dungeons are now accessible through portals in the Sanctuary below the Bergson’s house. The Sanctuary can be accessed by clicking on the fireplace in the house.
[*]Mental Bubbles Added: Gain insight into the family's well being by clicking on them in the house to see their thoughts.
[/list]

[h1]Misc[/h1]
[list]
[*]Improved Camera System: Improved performance for Event Rooms and special camera movements that now allow bosses and key objects to remain visible during encounters.
[*]Better pixel perfect interpretation implemented for enhanced visuals and improved performance.
[*]Various bugs and issues solved.
[*]Numerous balance changes
[/list]
